items.reason: Verifier results write timestamped Markdown reports under the set’s verify directory.
Filename collisions advance the stamp; reports are written once after the fallback walk concludes.
The response contract retains the verdict first, and remaining prose becomes the report body.
Verdict parsing remains unchanged; malformed replies retain raw text and absent replies retain an explanation.
Report writing runs for PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
The updated contract requires criterion-by-criterion findings for PASS.
Cache hits return before report creation.
Reports remain separate from the invalidated verdict cache.
Previous reports are excluded from Verifier prompts; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Accept writes a human report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the supplied rationale and overridden verdict.
The author field and explicit human-acceptance heading distinguish human reports.
Human reports use the same directory, timestamp format, shared header machinery, and latest-report reader.
The sign-off preamble shows the latest report path and recorded commit without its prose.
The paging action opens the report and returns to the gate menu.
The status detail view gains a Verify report pointer section.
Verify artifacts sort ahead of Refine artifacts.
Agent prompt views gain no report pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Missing Verify reports produce no corresponding preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Badge and verification-status derivation remain independent of report age.
rowStatusDetail and verifyMarkDetailParts still truncate findings without a report pointer; only the drain summary gains one.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, and document-header parsing.
Refine retains its directory, filename format, header, and existing surface rendering.
Refine prompt goldens are untouched.
